headline: Margins expand sharply and full-year outlook is raised
summary_short: Sales were $5.0B, up 1% reported and 7% organic; adjusted EPS rose 34% to $2.27 and segment margin expanded 370bp to 21.3%, so the company raised its 2026 outlook.
summary_long: Reported EPS fell 20% to $2.40 because the prior year included a one-time gain from the Resideo termination agreement. Building Automation grew 8% organically, Process Automation 8% and Industrial Automation 4%. Backlog rose 7% to nearly $19B excluding divestitures. Full-year guidance now: sales $20.0B-$20.1B, organic growth 4%-5%, adjusted EPS $8.40-$8.45 and free cash flow about $2.1B.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EPS, segment margin, organic growth and free cash flow are non-GAAP. First quarter as a standalone company after spin-offs, so reported sales growth is muted by divestitures. Operating cash flow of $607M fell 74% on the prior-year Resideo settlement.

drivers.explanation: Productivity, including elimination of stranded costs from prior spin-offs and divestitures, pricing that more than offset inflation, and volume leverage.
Prior-year results included a one-time gain from the Resideo termination agreement; adjusted EPS excludes it and rose.
Driven by organic sales growth, higher segment profit and lower net interest expense.
